InitCache LRU Limit Test Suite

Tests to validate that InitCache properly limits entries to MAX_CACHE_SIZE (50) using LRU eviction.

Test 1: Quality Switch Stress

Cycles through all quality levels 10 times to generate many init segment loads.

Test 2: Stream Switch Stress

Switches between 3 different streams 5 times each to simulate multi-content playback.

Test 3: Cache Overflow (Synthetic)

Directly inserts 100 entries to verify LRU eviction at limit.
